content_feed.telegram_post: 🤝 #ACQUISITION | Sejal Glass Limited (NSE: SEJALLTD) Sejal Glass to acquire Architectural and Automotive Glass business for ₹40.80 Cr ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Consideration: ₹40.80 Crore - Target: Architectural and Automotive Glass business of Magnumtuff India Pvt Ltd - Mode: Slump sale (going-concern basis) - Target FY26 Revenue: ₹36.20 Crore - Strategic Impact: Adds 4th manufacturing facility in Belgaum, Karnataka 📌 What happened: ↳ Sejal Glass has approved a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the glass business of Magnumtuff India, including land, building, and operational assets, to expand its manufacturing footprint in South India. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
